spec_match.rationale: Exercises the exact color(display-p3-linear r g b) surface from CSS Color 4 §10.2.6 side-by-side with display-p3, with the browser's own computed serialization as the readout.

interactive.rationale: Three sliders drive paired swatches and a generated 18-cell grey ladder; every state change updates chips, declarations, computed values and the live verdict.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the canonical 0.5-is-not-mid-grey surprise with slider comparison; the page delivers exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Rejected-value state renders an explicit hatched 'value rejected by this browser' chip — never a fake colour; the unsupported branch is the honestly-labelled fallback.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5162372125818880 and the spec section.

conformance.rationale: New feature-level suite covers parse, percentage, alpha, out-of-range, none, negative two-component case, RCS, computed round-trip and the exact transfer-curve value — the same contracts the page demonstrates.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 (pre-144 engine) via CDP/puppeteer: every control driven at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch; full-page screenshots read; console clean except a sandbox-blocked external Google Fonts fetch (net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET, environment egress proxy, not the demo); zero same-origin failures; zero horizontal overflow.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts probe-ran, computed-serialization on interaction, and an explicit fallback-branch assert when unsupported; no noisy console paths.

design_system.rationale: UI chrome uses CSS variables throughout; the only literal colour values are the color(display-p3[-linear] ...) declarations under test, which are the feature itself.

accessibility.rationale: Native labelled sliders with output elements, aria-live verdict, role=img ladder description, keyboard path verified via CDP (tab order + ArrowRight).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Zero page overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 after wrapping the grey ladder in an overflow-x scroller; 44px slider/button targets.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the supported path on Chrome 144+
openQuestions.detail: Verification ran on Chromium 141, which predates the feature, so only the unsupported/fallback branch could be exercised in-browser (it behaved correctly and honestly). When a 144+ Chrome/Canary is available, re-run the page: the support badge must flip, chips/bars must render in display-p3-linear, and the RCS cross-checks must report agreement within tolerance.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive demo layout without horizontal overflow mobile touch targets
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Design tokens/variables, >=44px touch targets, visible focus, :not()-style intent selectors, gradients/color-mix guidance.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All chrome UI colours use public/styles.css variables; range inputs and buttons have min-height 44px; native controls keep default focus rings; wide content scrolls in its own overflow-x container.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic sizing (minmax(min(Npx,100%),1fr)) grids instead of fixed columns so panels reflow on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Swatch pairs, converter panel, mix grid and supports cards all use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(...,100%),1fr)); dl uses max-content/minmax(0,1fr) after a squeezed-column bug was caught on the desktop screenshot and fixed.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: puppeteer probe: documentElement.scrollWidth - clientWidth == 0 at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 on all four concepts

guidanceConsulted.query: interactive color space demo slider controls accessible live readout
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Label every control, expose state changes through text/live regions, keep keyboard operability with native elements.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Sliders are native inputs wrapped in labels with output elements; verdict/readout containers use role=status aria-live=polite; grey ladder exposes a role=img description; tab order verified (crumbs -> sliders) and ArrowRight moves the slider and updates the readout.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP keyboard pass: activeElement sequence + slider 0.50->0.51 with readout update

summary: Built as the basic/canonical angle of the new v144 demo. Verified on headless Chromium 141: fallback branch (badge 'not supported here', amber note naming no-flag/no-OT, hatched rejected chips, display-p3 chip still live) all correct; sliders update declarations and computed readouts; ladder renders 9 display-p3 greys + 9 honest rejected cells. A 7px mobile overflow from the grey ladder was caught by measurement and fixed with a scroll container.
